title: Microsoft Purview DLP: Copilot label restrictions in Word, Excel and PowerPoint apply wherever the file is stored
summary: The briefing passes: the roadmap supports the storage-location extension, and Microsoft Learn supports the policy behaviour, licensing and PowerShell calls. The label-control navigation stops at the policy location rather than the rule settings; its note correctly describes the remaining configuration.

claims.where: title; summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The Copilot DLP restriction in Word, Excel and PowerPoint now applies regardless of file storage location.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.

claims.claim: The roadmap record was modified at 2026-07-17T22:12:56.
The printed Microsoft Purview portal path reaches the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location.
claims.quote: Go to Data Loss Prevention > Policies and select + Create policy. ... Select the Custom template, then Custom policy. ... On the Locations page, set the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork location to on.

claims.claim: New-DlpCompliancePolicy -Name "<policy-name>" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences") creates the scoped Copilot DLP policy.
claims.quote: New-DLPCompliancePolicy -Name "Copilot Policy" -Locations $loc -EnforcementPlanes @("CopilotExperiences")

claims.claim: The printed path for selecting the restricted sensitivity labels ends at the Copilot policy location.
claims.quote: To set this up, create DLP policies that use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location with the Content contains > Sensitivity labels condition to exclude items from being processed.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path beyond the policy location to the rule's 'Content contains > Sensitivity labels' condition. Retain the note instructing administrators to choose the labels and set 'Prevent Copilot and Cowork from processing content', as documented at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/dlp-microsoft365-copilot-location-learn-about.

claims.claim: New-DlpComplianceRule with -Policy, -AdvancedRule and -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"}) creates the label-processing restriction.
claims.quote: New-DLPComplianceRule -Name "Copilot Rule" -Policy "Copilot Policy" -AdvancedRule $advrule -RestrictAccess @(@{setting="ExcludeContentProcessing";value="Block"})

claims.claim: These cmdlets are available in Security & Compliance PowerShell.
claims.quote: This cmdlet is available only in Security & Compliance PowerShell.

claims.claim: $loc identifies Microsoft 365 Copilot with location GUID 470f2276-e011-4e9d-a6ec-20768be3a4b0.
claims.quote: Location: Where the DLP policy applies. For Microsoft 365 Copilot, use the value 470f2276-e011-4e9d-a6ec-20768be3a4b0.

claims.claim: The policy can include and exclude users and groups through its scope.
claims.quote: Exclusions: Exclude security groups, distribution groups, or users from the scope of this DLP policy.

claims.claim: $advRule specifies the sensitivity-label GUIDs for the rule.
claims.quote: The fifth command creates the variable named $advRule. The advanced rule needs to be updated depending on the grouping of labels you want to provide as input.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The DLP restriction is admin-opt-in: an administrator must configure a policy for it to enforce.
claims.quote: To set this up, create DLP policies that use the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy location with the Content contains > Sensitivity labels condition to exclude items from being processed.

claims.claim: The Content contains > Sensitivity labels condition on the Copilot location identifies the labelled content to restrict.
claims.quote: Content contains > Sensitivity labels ... Detects when a file or an email in Exchange has a chosen sensitivity label.

claims.claim: Matching items can still appear in response citations.
claims.quote: Identified items still appear in the citations of the response, but Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.claim: Copilot does not use the content of items matched by the label restriction in its response.
claims.quote: Copilot and Cowork don't access or use the content of the item in the response.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment; Governance guidance; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Copilot skills are disabled when a covered labelled file is open in Word, Excel or PowerPoint.
claims.quote: When a file is open in Word, Excel, or PowerPoint and has a sensitivity label for which DLP policy is configured to prevent processing by Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat, the skills in these apps are disabled.

claims.claim: The policy is evaluated at file open in Word, Excel and PowerPoint.
claims.quote: In Word, Excel, and PowerPoint the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork policy to prevent Copilot from processing content is evaluated at file open.

claims.claim: A sensitivity label applied mid-session causes enforcement starting the next time the file opens.
claims.quote: If a sensitivity label is applied mid-session, the policy will be enforced starting the next time the file is opened.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not describe the storage-location extension itself as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Purview Copilot DLP sensitivity labels all storage locations local network storage 557255. Read Copilot DLP Learn page and architecture-data-protection-auditing; results explain existing protection but not the storage-location rollout.

claims.claim: The extension covers files opened from local drives, network shares and other cloud storage as instances of any storage location.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.

claims.claim: Copilot honours protection settings on labelled or encrypted files stored outside Microsoft 365 while open in an Office app.
claims.quote: When a labeled or encrypted file stored outside Microsoft 365 (for example, on local storage, a network share, or another cloud service) is open in an Office app, Copilot honors the same protection settings.

claims.claim: Citations can reveal the existence of a restricted file to a user who has access to it.
claims.quote: A DLP policy for Copilot can keep Copilot from summarizing labeled files and emails. Copilot can still return a link so the user can open the item outside Copilot.

claims.claim: DLP cannot scan the contents of files uploaded directly into prompts.
claims.quote: DLP can't scan the contents of files that you upload directly into prompts, so evaluation of the uploaded file for sensitive data doesn't occur.

claims.claim: For directly uploaded prompt files, DLP checks only the text typed into the prompt.
claims.quote: DLP only checks the text you type into the prompt itself.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the initiating user's security context.
claims.quote: All Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts run in the security context of the user who initiates the prompt.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope: Users
claims.claim: Policy scoping follows the user submitting the prompt rather than the file owner.
claims.quote: DLP policy scoping for Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Cowork is based on the user who submits the prompt, not the owner of a file or email that the experience accesses.

claims.claim: The roadmap change extends a restriction rather than adding an autonomous Copilot action.
claims.quote: The Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention policy to restrict Microsoft 365 Copilot processing sensitive files in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint will now apply regardless of file storage location.

claims.claim: Some experiences that do not reference file content or do not use large language models are not currently blocked in the user interface.
claims.quote: Certain experiences that don't reference file content or that aren't using any large language models aren't currently blocked on the user experience.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance
claims.claim: DLP policy updates can take up to four hours to reach Copilot experiences.
claims.quote: Updates to a DLP policy can take up to four hours to reflect in the Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Chat, and Copilot Cowork experiences.
